title: Stucco monolithic plaster cladding on a 2000 extension (Aongatete)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
authority: Western Bay of Plenty District Council
code_edition: Building Code in force when consent 64033 was granted (October 2000)
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Extension to an existing dwelling added 2000–2001 under building consent 64033 (granted October 2000); external stucco monolithic plaster finish.
Refusal ground: authority not satisfied on reasonable grounds that the stucco monolithic plaster complies with E2 and B2.3.1 as it relates to E2.
Expert concluded the items are non-compliant; the determination treats them as construction defects rather than degradation through age, so the work would not have achieved compliance.
Discussion (§7) relies on BRANZ references and expert evidence.
Decision: authority correct to refuse the CCC under the Code in force when consent 64033 was granted (6 October 2022).
